newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANI to buy Saarberg stake in SHW.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANI to buy Saarberg stake in SHW.

text.p: Australian National Industries Ltd (ANI) said on Thursday it would repurchase the 50 percent share of Germany's Saarberg-Holter Wassertechnick (SHW) waste water treatment business from Saarbergwerke Ag.
ANI said the repurhase, which would give it full ownership of SHW, was based on the exercise of a put option held by Saarberg.
Saarberg bought the half share for 62 million marks in January this year and ANI would pay 65.5 million marks for this stake.
ANI said the 3.5 million mark difference reflected the fact that SHW had not paid dividends during 1996 and that its Holter unit would be entitled to the full 1996 dividend.
ANI said earlier this month it had allowed the expiry date for its call option over the SHW stake to expire.

ANI managing director Peter Stancliffe said the company was not disappointed that it had been forced to go to full ownership of SHW and there were some significant advantages from having full control, such as synergies with other operations.
He said SHW and ANI's half share in waste water treatment technology firm BioBalance A/S would eventually be sold.
ANI said the sales would occur by tender after SHW becomes a wholly-owned subsidiary in early January next year.

"Our intention to offer SHW for sale by international tender is consistent with the strategy, announced at the recent annual general meeting, of dealing with each of Holter's businesses separately," Stancliffe said.
"There have always been a number of parties other than Saarberg interested in the purchase of SHW and we will be pursuing these possibilities."
Holter is ANI's environmental engineering group based in Germany. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
